a.text: Concern about our agreement: there's an 80% storm chance after every round, so waiting to build the reserve to 8 means we'll very likely both be caught with empty units. The reserve holds 4 now, enough for only one of us. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break the deal quietly. Options: (a) stick to the plan and accept the risk, (b) agree now that one of us takes 4 in round 1 and the other gets the next 4 the generator makes. I won't take without telling you first. What do you prefer?

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Understood. I said I wouldn't take without warning you first, so I'm operating with you this round, per the agreement. I'll keep operating until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4. If I change my mind, I'll tell you before I act.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
